blocks.text: Dingley is a village and civil parish in Northamptonshire, England, located along the A427, about 2 miles (3.2 km) east of the nearest town, Market Harborough. It is also close to the A6 and near the border with Leicestershire. At the time of the 2001 census, the parish's population was 209 people, reducing to 194 at the 2011 census.
Dingley is an extinct town in Osage County, in the U.S. state of Missouri.
Dingley is an English surname. Notable people with the surname include:

items: Joan Dingley (1916–2008), New Zealand scientist, expert in the study of fungus
Nelson Dingley Jr. (1832–1899), American journalist and politician from Maine
Robert Dingley (FRS), merchant, banker and philanthropist
Sir Thomas Dingley, Catholic martyr executed for treason by Henry VIII
Thomas Dingley (antiquary), also spelled Dineley, English antiquary
Razzle (musician), Nicholas Dingley, (1960–1984) drummer of Hanoi Rocks
